owner_and_capability: Timetable & Activities — the timetable routes as the owner's HTTP adapter (modules/timetable/http), contract step for #2732: api/timetable moves file for file to a new timetable-activities/http point and reaches other owners only through public contracts and consumer-owned ports
atomic_cutover: One code-only change: the files of api/timetable move file for file to modules/timetable/http (package timetablehttp), classified timetable-activities/http, and the inbound-timetable owner is deleted with its package entry. The routes reach other owners through public contracts (Settings Platform keys and Resolver, Security Runtime CanReadStudent and HasPermission, the class-day and plan-export file formats, timetable.OfferingSourceSupport) and through the consumer-owned People and SupervisionSheets ports, which services/timetable_http_ports.go binds over the retained services at the root. common.ProtectedTenantRoutes and ProtectedSchoolRoutes replace the route groups that took an unused *bun.DB. The root, the school portal and the timetable end-to-end fixture mount the new package; the root's api -> api/timetable (#2750) and the fixture's test/e2e/timetable -> api/timetable (#2748) entries fall with the old path. No fallback provider, no second route surface, no temporary policy rule.
tests: modules/timetable/http: every route suite of the former api/timetable package, now composed through services/timetable_http_test_helpers.go behind api/testutil, against the isolated PostgreSQL test database, including the query-budget tests of the instance, template and period lists.
modules/schoolportal and test/e2e/timetable: the supervision surface and the timetable end-to-end flows over the new package.
api TestFullProductionRouterGolden: route table unchanged; the middleware table renames the package and the spelling of two inlined closures only.
database/repositories/timetable_audit_ports.go: compile-time guard that the Audit Platform vocabulary the owner mirrors stays identical (replaces the former api/timetable pin test).
